overview: 2026年公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售事项；已披露的公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会及股息安排。最新一季（截至2026年6月30日）营收24,547,000 MYR，同比增43.7%；净利润4,155,000 MYR，同比增162.5%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal of business segments in its announcements; the announcements mainly covered quarterly results, general meetings, and dividend arrangements. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 24,547,000, up 43.7% year-on-year; net profit was MYR 4,155,000, up 162.5% year-on-year.
